claims: C1 content omitted due to legal requirements above and beyond the Model Spec's boundaries must be transparently indicated to the user
C2 the indication must occur in each model response
C3 the indication must specify the type of information removed and the rationale for its removal
C4 the indication must not disclose the redacted content itself

concepts.name: omitted_content
concepts.gloss: O is content that was omitted from a response because legal requirements for a local deployment required its removal, where those requirements go beyond the boundaries set in this Model Spec
concepts.inference: the node's claim speaks of 'content omitted due to legal requirements above and beyond the boundaries in this Model Spec'; the class of such content is presupposed without being defined

concepts.name: legal_requirement_omission
concepts.gloss: O is content whose omission is attributable to legal requirements rather than to the Model Spec's own boundaries
concepts.inference: the claim distinguishes omissions due to legal requirements from those within the Model Spec's boundaries; this predicate marks that distinction

concepts.name: model_response
concepts.gloss: R is a model response in which the omission occurs
concepts.inference: the claim requires indication 'in each model response', so a relation between an omission and the response it occurs in is presupposed

concepts.name: omission_in_response
concepts.gloss: omission O occurs in model response R
concepts.inference: the claim requires indication in each model response, which presupposes that an omission is located in a particular response

concepts.name: specify_type_and_rationale
concepts.gloss: the indication of O states the type of information removed and the rationale for its removal

concepts.name: not_disclose_redacted
concepts.gloss: the indication of O does not disclose the redacted content itself

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of the system, as defined by the shared-name contract
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's source text does not define the system authority level

asserts.read_back: omitted content % must be transparently indicated in each model response, specifying the type of information removed and the rationale for its removal, without disclosing the redacted content itself
asserts.body: omitted_content(O), legal_requirement_omission(O), model_response(R), omission_in_response(O,R), specify_type_and_rationale(O), not_disclose_redacted(O)

closure.reason: the clause obliges transparent indication only for content omitted due to legal requirements beyond the Model Spec's boundaries; it does not address other omissions, so silence permits them
